Read the sound design session: loaded source (path, rate, channels, frames) and the current intensity curve with its version

Load one audio file (WAV at any rate/bit depth, MP3, FLAC, OGG/Vorbis, M4A/AAC) as the sound design source, decoded to 48 kHz mono/stereo (replaces the current session; the source file is never modified)
Apply one stroke to a lane (intensity or tone). mode=draw replaces the lane over the stroke span; mode=brush adds (above 0.5) or removes (below) on top and reports hitLimit when clamped
Replace a whole lane (intensity or tone; empty list = original/bypassed)
Render the frozen current controls (intensity + tone) with the same processor as playback and write a 48 kHz 24-bit WAV; refuses to overwrite the source
Undo the last curve edit of the session
Redo the last undone curve edit
Save the session as a versioned project JSON (source path + size + sha256, both lanes, algorithm version); written via temp file then rename
Open a project; fails with SOURCE_MISSING / SOURCE_CHANGED unless sourcePath relinks it or confirmChangedSource is true
Start playback of the loaded sound from a frame (default 0) with the session A/B monitor state; restarts if already playing
Stop sound design playback; the A/B monitor state is kept for the next play
Read sound design playback state: playing, current frame, A/B monitor (original or processed) and any device error
A/B switch: listen to the original (original=true) or processed sound; while playing it crossfades in 20 ms from the current position without restarting, while stopped it applies to the next play
Close the sound design session: stop playback and release the source (unsaved curve edits are discarded)

Edit keyframes on one lane as one undo step: ops move{id,frame,level} / add{frame,level,interpOut?,easeIn?,easeOut?} / delete{id} / setEase{id,interpOut?,easeIn?,easeOut?}; the batch is validated on its final state and fails atomically; returns new ids and canonical lanes
Set a lane default interpolation (ease/linear/hold) for new strokes; applyToAll also changes every existing key on that lane in one undo step
Begin an edit gesture on the sound design session; returns gestureId and baseVersion. Previews never commit; commit or cancel ends it
Preview a stroke or key edit for a gesture (seq must increase); computed from the committed base by the same core as a commit, auditioned by the player, not added to undo
Commit the previewed candidate of a gesture (same seq) as one version and one undo step; fails with CONFLICT if the curve changed meanwhile
Cancel a gesture: drop its candidate and return playback to the committed curve
